**Key Findings:**
- Kade Anderson is ranked as the best pitching prospect in baseball (MLB.com, Aug 14, 2026)
- He's been dominant at Double-A: 1.13 ERA, 0.65 WHIP
- CBS Sports reports Anderson is "scheduled to meet with the Mariners' brass Wednesday to map out a plan for his call-up to Seattle in the coming weeks"
- A prospect model projects an expected call-up date of August 20, with the realistic window running from early August through September roster expansion
- The model gives only a 23% chance of debuting within the 90-day window closing September 9
- Anderson "will start when called up" — the Mariners view him as a rotation piece
- Multiple sources mention September call-up as likely

- Service time considerations and innings limits could push the debut to September
- The Mariners have been cautious with their top prospect's timeline

The market is essentially at my entry price (32% vs 33% entry), so I'm roughly break-even. The positive news about active call-up discussions supports holding, but the market isn't dramatically mispriced and there's genuine uncertainty about whether Anderson debuts before September 1 versus waiting for roster expansion.
